characterization_methods: Cross-sectional High Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy (HRTEM)
evidence: The physical thickness and the density of the films were evaluated from X-ray reflectivity (XRR) data. The layer density of Ti ions in the films was measured by X-ray fluorescence (XRF) spectroscopy. The crystalline structure of the TiO2 films was investigated by glancing angle X-ray diffraction (GAXRD) with an angle of incidence of 1°. The surface morphology of the films was examined using atomic force microscopy (AFM). The carbon content in the films was analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) after Ar ion sputtering for 1 min. The microstructure of the films was examined with cross-sectional high resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM).
